items.description: `0 ≤ reserved_qty ≤ on_hand_qty` for every stock row; **never oversell**.
Inventory ledger sums match `on_hand_qty`; wallet ledger sums match balances.
An order total equals the sum of its frozen line items, fees, taxes and discounts, **to the paisa**.
A payment is captured **at most once** per order for the same amount; a refund never exceeds captured minus already refunded.
A delivery task has **at most one active rider**; a rider has at most `max_concurrent_tasks` (config).
An order has at most one active delivery task and one pick task.
A coupon redemption count never exceeds its limits, even under concurrent checkouts.
Every state change has a history row and an outbox event in the same transaction.
Invoice numbers are gapless and unique per (legal entity, financial year); issued invoices are immutable (corrections are credit notes).
Subscription order generation is idempotent per `(subscription_id, delivery_date)`.
